body:
Released in [`@emseepea/feedback` 0.9.0](https://github.com/emseepea/emseepea/releases/tag/%40emseepea%2Ffeedback%400.9.0). `FeedbackSubmissionOptions.annotations` accepts optional `readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`, `idempotentHint`, and `openWorldHint` booleans. `FeedbackConversationOptions.annotations` maps the exact public MCP tool names to independent partial overrides. Omitted or undefined flags retain current defaults; unknown keys and non-boolean values fail before registration.

[The feedback guide](https://emseepea.github.io/emseepea/feedback/#classify-your-backends-effects) documents classification of the complete backend and hook chain, including retention writes, notice cancellation, and irreversible delivery effects. Annotation configuration changes discovery descriptors without changing authorization, persistence, hook dispatch, or retries. Collection and operator helpers keep their existing contracts.

Real MCP-client checks cover the issue’s two-read activity-write reproduction, per-operation overrides, public and protected discovery and submission, unchanged hooks, defaults, invalid configuration, and configuration mutation. These checks also pass against fresh packed installs. Exact-source qualification, Source Quality, semantic Release checks, registry verification, and Publish have passed. Feedback 0.9.0 and all eleven initializer updates are verified on npm latest; the guide is deployed.
